'''Cakes''' were a form of confectionery in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. A magnificent wedding cake could also be found at celebrations for the occasion of a marriage.<ref name="swg">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Wedding Cake}}</ref> A sweet cake mix was used as an ingredient for certain cakes such as [[Citros snow cake]] and [[Pyollian cake]].<ref name="swg2">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Sweet Cake Mix}}</ref>
